Sumo is a local two-player game. Blue plays from the top of the screen and red plays from the bottom. Both players tap READY to begin the ceremony and start the bout.

Use the joystick on your side of the screen to move your rikishi around the dohyō. Rapidly tapping a joystick direction gives a short extra burst of force. If Full Contact is enabled in Settings, you can also drag your rikishi directly.
Push and Pull buttons light up during a bout. Tap an available move for a brief advantage, then use it to take control of the ring.

Force your opponent outside the tawara to take health. After a non-final hit, both rikishi return to the Shikiri-sen. Empty your opponent's health bar to win; after the result ceremony, both players can tap READY for the next bout.
